subtopic: Investment Risk and Insurance Company Risk
source_evidence: If the investment options you selected for the variable annuity perform poorly, you could lose money. If the insurance company experiences financial distress, it may not be able to pay what it owes you under your policy.
answer: A variable annuity has two distinct kinds of risk. Investment risk means your contract value and returns depend on how your chosen investment options perform, so poor performance can lead to losses, including loss of your original investment. Insurance company risk is the possibility that the company backing the contract’s guarantees may face financial distress and be unable to pay what it owes. Investment performance and the insurer’s ability to meet its obligations are separate considerations.
